name: Regulatory and Compliance Gate Audit
phase: Hypothesis Framing and Assumption Mapping Tactics
hypothesis: We believe our proposed data architecture complies fully with relevant regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2). We will verify this by completing a formal compliance audit with an external specialist, and consider it validated if the audit reveals zero critical regulatory blockers that would require fundamentally altering the product model.

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Document data lifecycles, consent mechanisms, storage tiers and cross-border transfer paths.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Walk legal and compliance specialists through the end-to-end data flow to find every regulatory touchpoint.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Log legal hurdles, certification costs and implementation timelines against the product model.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Document data lifecycles, user consent mechanisms, storage tiers, and cross-border transfer paths.

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Walk legal and compliance specialists through the end-to-end data flow to identify regulatory touchpoints.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Log potential legal hurdles, compliance requirements, certification expenses, and expected implementation timelines.

warning.label: Informal Legal Assurances
warning.text: Casual early guidance from corporate counsel is mistaken for formal, binding regulatory clearance.

warningFull: Early-stage teams frequently mistake casual, preliminary guidance from corporate attorneys for formal, binding regulatory clearance.
